summary: FlatMate+ v3 code-quality bug-fix pass verified end-to-end. Backend regression: all 22/22 pytest cases pass (backend_test.py: 4 core swipe/match/messages/WS + backend_test_v3.py: 18 geo/nn/liveness/profile/edit/discover) after serve_file rewrite — media_type resolves via `(record or {}).get('content_type') or ct or 'application/octet-stream'`. Direct serve_file smoke: real jpeg served with content-type 'image/jpeg' (200), unknown path -> 404. Frontend Chat.jsx verified at 420x900: (a) with valid photo user the renders with src=/api/files/... and no innerHTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere; (b) with no-photo user the Avatar fallback div shows the initial letter ('U' for 'UI4 A'); (c) forcing img.onError swaps to the same letter fallback (state-based); (d) sending a message renders outgoing bubble; (e) simulated auth failure produces console.error('Send failed', AxiosError) + sonner toast "Couldn't send. Try again." — matching the fixed catch blocks. Discover mounts and loads a card; Matches lists the pair with last_message preview; EditProfile prefills user name. No XSS payloads observed and no react-hooks stale-closure symptoms.
critical_code_review_comments: serve_file: `record` is queried but not required when file was uploaded via a legacy path (selfie_user branch). Current fallback `(record or {}).get('content_type') or ct or 'application/octet-stream'` is safe. Fine.
Chat.jsx Avatar: correctly uses useState('broken') + onError; no innerHTML, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Good.
Chat.jsx WS 'onerror' currently logs to console only — no user-facing toast; acceptable but a small connection-lost banner would improve UX.
Discover.jsx one-shot mount uses explicit eslint-disable-next-line; document reason in a nearby comment for future maintainers.
Iteration_3 pre-existing (still open, not in scope of this pass): activeFiltersCount counts default budget/radius as active; DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning).
